theorems.name: Submission.intcpt_diag_rescaled_integrable
theorems.statement: ∀ (N n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclidean N)) (V : Varifold N n U) (ξ : Euclidean N) (t : ℝ) (F : C_c(Euclidean N × Grassmannian N n, ℝ)), 0 < t → (∀ z ∈ tsupport F, ξ + t • z.1 ∈ U) → Integrable (fun z ↦ F z) (rescaledMeasure V ξ t)
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
